name: CrossoverDistortion
description: Class B/AB power amp distortion simulation. Models the crossover distortion that occurs when the signal crosses zero. For class B simulations set smooth to ~0.3 (+/- 0.2); for class AB set smooth near 1.0. Port of LADSPA plugin (plugin ID 1404). From sc3-plugins DistortionUGens.

inputs.name: amp
inputs.description: Controls the point at which the output signal becomes linear

inputs.name: smooth
inputs.description: Degree of smoothing of the crossover point

name: Decimator
description: Sample rate and bit depth reduction. Decimates the input signal — accepts non-integer values for both rate and bits, allowing smooth transitions between clean and lo-fi signals. Port of LADSPA plugin (plugin ID 1202). From sc3-plugins DistortionUGens.

inputs.name: rate
inputs.description: Sample rate at which the signal will be resampled (Hz)

inputs.name: bits
inputs.description: Bit depth that the signal will be reduced to (non-integer values allowed)

name: SmoothDecimator
description: Smooth sample rate reduction. Decimates the input signal with adjustable smoothing of the resampled output. From sc3-plugins DistortionUGens.

inputs.name: rate
inputs.description: Rate at which the output signal will be resampled (Hz)

inputs.name: smoothing
inputs.description: Amount of smoothing applied to the resampled output (0 to 1)

name: SineShaper
description: Sine-based wave shaper. Applies a sinusoidal transfer function to the input — soft saturation distortion limited by the supplied limit value. Port of a LADSPA plugin. From sc3-plugins DistortionUGens.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Limit at which the sinusoidal shaping caps the output

name: Disintegrator
description: Amplifies random half-cycles of the input by a multiplier. Set multiplier to 0 and vary probability for a weird fade effect; set multiplier to -1 and probability to 0.5 to turn pitched sounds into noise. Port of LADSPA plugin (plugin ID 1846). From sc3-plugins DistortionUGens.

inputs.name: probability
inputs.description: Probability that a given half-cycle is amplified (0 to 1)

inputs.name: multiplier
inputs.description: Gain applied to selected half-cycles (e.g. -1 inverts, 0 mutes)
